[Notice] Official Launch Announcement
Oct 7
Hello, Commanders!
This is War of Genesis: Idle Loot.

Following about a month of Early Access that began on September 10, we are finally celebrating our official launch alongside the October 7 update.

Thanks to your enthusiastic support, we reached a peak of 52,800 concurrent players during the Early Access period, and we were able to receive a wide variety of valuable feedback for the game's improvement. We would like to express our deepest gratitude to all the Commanders who joined us on this journey.

Even though Early Access has concluded, our commitment to listening to your voices will never stop. Based on the diverse feedback and gameplay experiences you share with us, our entire development team will continue to do our very best to make the game even more enjoyable and polished.

We ask for your continued love and support as we embark on this new official launch journey, and we will always strive to provide you with an exciting and engaging gaming experience.

Thank you.

[Update] October 7 Update Announcement
Oct 6
Hello, Commanders!
This is War of Genesis: Idle Loot.

This update will introduce new skin content, profile images, frames, G-Coins, raid rewards, and artifacts, along with fixes for several issues.
Please see below for the update details and maintenance schedule.

■ Maintenance Schedule
- October 7 (Wed), 14:00 ~ 17:00 (KST)
- October 7 (Wed), 05:00 ~ 08:00 (UTC)
※ The KST and UTC schedules show the same maintenance period in their respective time zones.

■ Improvements and Additions

1. New Skin Content
- New Skins
└ Three Tier 4 skins, two Tier 5 skins, and one Tier 6 skin will be added for each class: Knight, Ranger, and Wizard.
└ Skins can be obtained from Fancy Skin Boxes sold in the Shop or through Roulette on the Skin page.
└ You can access the Skin page by selecting the Skin button above your user level in the main character window.
└ The new Tier 6 skins will be available for a limited time during 2026.
└ Skin content unlocks at user level 20.
- New Skin Product
└ Fancy Skin Boxes, which contain skins, will be added to the Shop.
└ Using a Fancy Skin Box grants a Tier 4–6 skin according to the specified probabilities.
└ When you obtain a Tier 6 skin, you will receive one you do not already own. If you own all Tier 6 skins, you will receive one of the Tier 6 skins.
- Skin Synthesis
└ A Skin Synthesis system will be added, allowing you to use duplicate skins for synthesis.
└ When you obtain a Tier 6 skin through synthesis, you will receive one you do not already own. If you own all Tier 6 skins, you will receive one of the Tier 6 skins.
└ If you own all Tier 6 skins, you cannot perform synthesis using Tier 6 skins as materials.
└ Synthesis grants Fragments of Mastery, which can be used to purchase frames.
- Exclusive Tier 6 Cutscenes
└ Equipping a Tier 6 skin will trigger an exclusive cutscene at regular intervals.
└ Each time the exclusive cutscene plays, you can obtain either a Crystal of Mastery or a Fragment of Mastery, both of which can be used to purchase frames.
└ You can obtain a combined total of up to 5 units of frame purchase currency per day through these cutscenes, regardless of currency type.
- Roulette
└ A Roulette feature will be added, offering Fancy Skin Boxes and Skin Box Exchange Stones.
└ Roulette uses a currency that replenishes at regular intervals.
└ Skin Box Exchange Stones can be exchanged for Fancy Skin Boxes in the Roulette Shop.

2. New Profile Images
- Profile images will be added.
└ Your profile image will reflect your current character and equipped skin.

3. New Frames
- Frames will be added to decorate your profile icon.
└ Frames can be purchased from Skin > Frame > Frame Shop.

4. New In-Game Currency: G-Coin
- G-Coins will be added as a currency for purchasing paid products.
- G-Coins can be purchased on the Shop page.

5. Additional Raid Rewards
- New Machina rewards will be added to the raid alliance and alliance member rewards.
- The new rewards will be granted to all members of alliances that did not finish in 1st place.

6. New Artifacts
- Equipment artifacts will be added.
└ One artifact will be added for each tier from Tier 3 to Tier 6.

7. Combat Power Ranking Display Range
- The Combat Power Ranking will be changed to display only the top 15,000 players.

■ Fixes
- An issue where the Ranger’s Lv. 65 Special Bullets was incorrectly translated as increasing range instead of poison damage in languages other than Korean will be fixed.
- An issue where the Ranger’s Lv. 45 Precision Aim was incorrectly translated as increasing poison accuracy instead of poison power in languages other than Korean will be fixed.
- An issue where the Wizard’s Lv. 55 Mana Circulation displayed text related to HP recovery instead of increased fire power in languages other than Korean and English will be fixed.
- An issue where the Wizard’s Lv. 45 Ignite displayed only accuracy instead of fire accuracy in languages other than Korean and English will be fixed.
- An issue where the Store All function stored items starting from Storage 1 instead of the selected storage will be fixed.
- Lv. 105 equipment will be made available for synthesis.

※ Maintenance details may change during development and testing.

We will continue listening to your valuable feedback and making improvements so that all Commanders can enjoy the game in a more stable and comfortable environment.

Thank you for your interest and feedback. We will keep doing our best to provide a better service.

Thank you.

[Update] September 17 Update Announcement
Sep 16

Hello, Commanders!
This is War of Genesis: Idle Loot.

In this update, we are making convenience improvements and content additions based on various suggestions and feedback received through the in-game suggestion box and Customer Support.
New convenience features such as chat translation, presets, and jewel auto-combine will be added, along with improvements and bug fixes for Raid and World Boss content.
Please check below for details regarding the update and maintenance schedule.

■ Maintenance Schedule
September 17 (Thu) 14:00 – 18:00 (KST)
September 17 (Thu) 05:00 – 09:00 (UTC)
(Maintenance times are identical in KST and UTC.)

■ Improvements & Additions
1. Preset Feature Added
- Configured items will now be saved and maintained according to your active character's class: Knight, Ranger, or Wizard.
- Growth: You can configure presets by tapping the number drop-down at the bottom of the Training Ground and Ability Unlock windows.
└ After configuring presets, select the preset number you wish to use for Training Ground and Ability Unlock in the Character Info window to apply it.

2. Chat System Improvements
- Chat participation requirements have been improved.
└ The combat power ranking eligible for chat participation has been expanded from top 3,000 to top 10,000.
- Chat translation feature added.
└ Messages in the chat window can now be translated into your selected language.
- Improved chat input field to allow you to review the full text of your message while typing.
- Added a feature to view information of other Commanders directly from the chat list.

3. Jewel Convenience Improvements
- Auto-Combine feature added for Jewels.
└ Available after configuring the target Jewel tier at the bottom of the existing Auto-Combine settings window.
- Right-clicking a Jewel item now directly opens the Jewel socketing window.

4. Steam Community Market Item Delivery Improvement
- Items purchased or retrieved from the Steam Community Market will now be delivered directly to your Inventory.

5. Arena Convenience Feature Added
- Added a refresh button to update the list of opponents in the Arena.

6. Raid & World Boss Improvements
- Daily entry limits for Raid and World Boss are now capped at 10 times each.
- Improved display of character status effects during Raid and World Boss battles.
└ Added buff/debuff icons and a dedicated Stun animation.
- A strategy guide button will be added to Raid and World Boss screens, allowing you to view boss tactics by hovering your mouse.
- Added a feature where Stun Immunity is applied according to your character's Stun Resistance whenever the Raid Boss level increases.

7. Ranking Improvements
- Added an info notice button to Raid Alliance Rankings.
└ Hover your mouse over the button to view details. (Alliance Rankings are calculated by combining the damage dealt by the top 100 members of each Alliance.)
- Added a new Tier 5 Machina as a reward for the #1 individual player in each Alliance, excluding the #1 Alliance.
- Added an Alliance inspection feature to Raid Alliance Rankings (supports ranking info by Alliance).
- Added an indicator in the rankings to check whether you will be promoted to the next league next season.
- Added a feature to view information of other Commanders directly from the ranking list.

8. Contract Product Benefits Added
- Addressed feedback regarding benefits of Expedition Contract and Subjugator's Contract being inactive during off-seasons; benefits can now be received even during Raid and World Boss off-seasons.
- Added daily distribution of Unlock Stones and Training Tokens during the contract period upon purchasing Expedition Contract or Subjugator's Contract.
└ Expedition Contract: 5,000 Training Tokens distributed daily during the period
└ Subjugator's Contract: 5,000 Unlock Stones distributed daily during the period
- To ensure no disadvantages for Commanders who purchased these contracts prior to the patch, currency will be distributed retroactively based on the purchase period after maintenance.

■ Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where status icons were not displayed in Raid and World Boss.
- Fixed an issue where the red notification dot was not displayed when ranking rewards were claimable.
- Fixed character red notification dots to only display when there is a character available for purchase.
- Fixed the Storage window to retain the last opened tab upon opening.
- Fixed an issue where identical poison damage was reapplied if the boss level changed while poisoned.
- Fixed an issue where combine success rates for Lv. 5 equipment were not displayed during equipment combining.
- Fixed an issue where Pet equipped effects (increased EXP gain from defeating normal monsters/bosses) were not being applied.
- Fixed an issue where Wing equipped effects (increased Gold gain from defeating normal monsters/bosses) were not being applied.
- Adjusted window resizing behavior according to monitor resolutions.
- Fixed an issue where sound played unexpectedly when exiting the game.
- (Added) Fixed an issue where the level requirement reduction effect remained applied after equipping gear using a Level Reduction Jewel and then converting it to another jewel.

※ Maintenance details are subject to change depending on development and testing progress.

We will continue to listen closely to the valuable feedback from our Commanders and strive to provide a more stable and enjoyable gaming experience.
Thank you for your warm support, and we will do our utmost to deliver a better service.

Thank you.

[Notice] Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Sep 14

Hello, Commanders!
This is War of Genesis: Idle Loot.

Here is a summary of frequently asked questions from our Commanders across Discord, the community, Steam Discussions, and Customer Support.

Q. How are the Raid Alliance Rankings calculated?
A. The damage dealt by the top 100 members of each Alliance is combined, and Alliances are ranked from highest to lowest total damage.

Q. Where can I find the Ether Shop?
A. You can access it by going to \[Battlefield] > \[Arena] at the bottom of the main menu, then tapping the \[Ether Shop] tab at the top.

Q. Where can I obtain Machina?
A. They can be obtained through Raid ranking rewards or purchased from the Arena's Ether Shop. (Usable for 7 days after acquisition.)

Q. Where can I use Auto-Combine?
A. Upon reaching User Level 17, tap the icon at the bottom of the Inventory to run Auto-Combine. In the settings, you can configure Auto-Combine by tier, level, or identical levels for Equipment and Accessories.

Q. What happens to equipped gear when changing to a character of a different class?
A. Weapons, secondary weapons, and skills must be newly equipped to match the selected class.

Q. Can I combine and dismantle items other than equipment at the Blacksmith?
A. Yes. At the bottom of the Blacksmith menu, you will find tabs for Equipment, Accessories, Pets, Wings, Runes, Jewels, and the Refinery. Simply select the desired tab.

Q. Where can I get materials to enhance Relics?
A. You can obtain Tier-specific Relic materials by combining or dismantling Tier 3 Equipment, Accessories, Pets, Wings, and Runes.

Q. What are the benefits of leveling up the Training Ground and Ability Unlock?
A. Higher levels increase the probability of higher ranks appearing.

Q. Is there any reason to purchase characters of other classes besides my main character?
A. Purchasing each character grants stat bonuses through their "Owned Effect," even if you do not actively use them.

Q. Where can I change the stage difficulty and area?
A. Go to \[Stage] at the bottom of the main menu, then select your desired difficulty from the bottom difficulty drop-down list or tap an area to enter.

Q. I have funds in my Steam Wallet, but I cannot purchase items from the shop.
A. If the Steam Overlay is disabled, payments may not process properly. Please go to the game's \[Manage] > \[Properties] in your Steam Library and ensure that the \[Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game] option is turned on.

Q. The World Boss or Raid season ended before I could receive my Pet or Wings reward. Can I no longer get them?
A. World Boss and Raid operate on a seasonal basis. Once a new season begins, participating in the content will allow you to earn ranking rewards such as Pets or Wings based on that season's ranking settlement.

Q. I cannot see items I purchased or retrieved from the Marketplace. Where can I claim them?
A. You can view these items in-game under \[Marketplace] > \[Storage List]. Tapping \[Claim] will send them to your Mailbox, where you can then collect them.

Q. Where can I adjust the audio volume?
A. You can adjust the Background Music and Sound Effects volume in-game under \[Menu] > \[Settings] > \[Sound].

If you have any other questions or need assistance beyond what is covered here, please feel free to reach out through Customer Support at any time.

Thank you.

[Notice] Upcoming Content Improvements & Update Roadmap
Sep 11

Hello, Commanders!
This is War of Genesis: Idle Loot.

Thanks to your enthusiastic support and interest, our Early Access launched smoothly on September 10.
We are carefully reviewing all the valuable opinions and suggestions sent via our Discord community, Steam Discussions, and Customer Support.
Please feel free to share any great ideas with us at any time!

Based on the feedback we have received, here is a preview of the upcoming improvements currently in development.

\[Upcoming Improvements]

■ Expansion of Preset Features
The development team plans to develop various preset setups internally and conduct phased testing.
We are preparing to expand presets beyond Equipment and Skills to include content such as the Training Ground and Ability Unlock, allowing you to set and switch presets more conveniently.

■ Auto-Combine Feature Improvements (Auto-Combine Jewels Added)
An Auto-Combine feature for Jewels will be added!
Currently, Auto-Combine only applies to Equipment and Accessories, which has led to Jewels taking up valuable Inventory space.
We plan to support Auto-Combine for Jewels as well, helping you manage your Inventory much more efficiently and comfortably.

■ Chat System Convenience Improvements
We noticed that far more Commanders are actively using in-game chat than anticipated.
We are preparing various chat convenience features, including an in-game auto-translation feature, to facilitate smooth communication among global Commanders.

■ Steam Community Market Item Retrieval Improvements
Currently, when purchasing items from the Steam Community Market, they are delivered to the 'Storage List' within the Marketplace.
To provide a more intuitive and convenient retrieval process, purchased items will soon be delivered directly to your 'Mailbox'.

■ Raid Visual Clarity Improvements
We will improve the visual effect of the 'Stun' status inflicted on monsters and targets during Raid battles so that it can be identified much more clearly in combat.

The detailed update schedule will be announced in a follow-up notice once confirmed.
※ Please note that the details mentioned above may be subject to change during the update preparation process.

In addition to the items above, we will continue to make improvements and updates based on your valuable feedback.
We look forward to your continued interest and support.

Thank you.
